SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. I. O. D.: 72
CENTRAL I. B.: Station
Date....................
Date February 28, 1929

Subject (in full) Z. Voronina.

Made by P.C.S. Maklaevsky. Forwarded by Jhd Rubinstein, C.D.I

With reference to the attached translation
of an article called "Union to Establish Justice on Earth",
the original of which appeared in the "Shanghai Zarya" of
February 21, signed by Z. Voronina, Initiator and first
member of the Union, inquiries go to show that the lady in
question, who is so far the only member of the Union, resides
at 41 Joffre Terrace, Avenue Joffre, and appears to be
mentally affected. In 1925 Mrs. Voronina arrived in Harbin
from Moscow and for 4 years was employed as a teacher of
the English language and governess. In December 1928 she left
Harbin for Tientsin and on being unable to find employment
arrived in Shanghai on February 1. Her object in coming to
this city is to establish the "Union to Establish Justice
on Earth", but as her attempts to do this are treated by the
Russian Community as a joke, she is not likely to be
successful.

B. Maklaevsky.
P. C. S.

H.R. 1/3

由警佐马克拉耶夫斯基（Maklaevsky）撰写。由刑事调查主任鲁宾斯坦（Jhd Rubinstein）转呈

关于所附题为《在人间建立正义联盟》一文的译文，原文刊登于2月21日的《上海霞报》（Shanghai Zarya），署名为该联盟的发起人和第一位成员Z. 沃罗尼娜。经查询显示，这位女士目前是该联盟的唯一成员，居住于霞飞路霞飞坊41号，似乎患有精神疾病。沃罗尼娜夫人于1925年从莫斯科抵达哈尔滨，并在随后的4年里担任英语教师和女家庭教师。1928年12月，她离开哈尔滨前往天津，因未能找到工作，于2月1日抵达上海。她来此城市的目的旨在建立“在人间建立正义联盟”，但由于俄国侨民社区将她的尝试视为笑谈，她不太可能取得成功。

B. 马克拉耶夫斯基。

Translation from the "Shanghai Zarya" Feb. 2I (Afternoon).
General.

"Union to establish justice on earth".

The purpose of the above Union is to make human beings
wise and to establish justice amongst them.
The method to attain this is as follows:-
I) The establishing of peace in one's soul. Every member of
the Union must feel at peace. To attain this ideal such
member should train him or herself to it if unable to
experience it at once.
The way to train. What should not be done:-
1) Not to eat meat. To remember that the consumption of
meat is an animal instinct and the source of all vice.
2) Not to give way to despair. To remember that sadness
is a result of wrong actions.
3) Not to get angry. Impatience is a result of attachment
to trifles of life. In order to avoid anger and impatience
it is necessary to dwell on things of more importance.
4) Not to be envious. Envy is a result of indolence. It is
necessary to work hard in order to attain one's desires.
5) Not to judge your neighbour. Judging your neighbour is
a sign of thoughtlessness.
6) Not to tell lies. Lying is a result of cowardice and is
lowering of one's dignity. In order not to lie one should
always esteem oneself.
7) Not to commit adultery in thought. Adultery is a result
of idle thoughts and vanity.
What should be done:-
1) To be always gay, assured in oneself, cheerful and friendly.
To laugh, sing, dance a lot and to admire nature and flowers.
To be similar to children in private life and resemble lions
in public life.
2) To be reasonable in love, to avoid mistakes.
The result of establishing peace in one's soul is eternal
youth, the disappearance of sickness and death. A human
being who has attained an ideal becomes immortal.
II) The establishing of peace and quiet in the human race.
1) To free humanity from the disease of to-day - Red Bolshevism.
Bolshevism is the result of the sins of humanity as such.
Bolshevism will disappear as soon as the Union to establish
justice will become sufficiently extended so as to expiate
the sins committed by humanity up to the present time.
2) Fraternation unification of the nations.
3) The donation of land to the people, who have not got it.
Everyone can become a member of the Union irrespective
of sex, age, position, nationality and religion.
All those who will resent being members of the Union
will be called grave-diggers, those who will hesitate -
errants whilst members of the Union will be known as
builders. Any member who has attained the state of ideal
will be called an egotist and becomes a participant of
another sphere of existence thereby acquiring the gift
of all-powerfulness.

Z. Vernina,
Initiator and first member of the Union.

Editorial Note:- This document was presented to us by
the initiator herself and we publish it for purposes of
information. We cannot quite understand why all non
Vegetarians and those who fail to enroll as members of
the Union are called "Grave-diggers". We fear in this
case that there will be many more millions "grave-diggers"
than members of the Union.

译自2月21日（下午版）《上海霞报》。
综合新闻。

“在人间建立正义联盟”。

上述联盟的宗旨是使人类变得智慧，并在他们中间建立正义。
实现这一目标的方法如下：
I) 建立内心的平静。联盟的每位成员必须感到内心平静。为了达到这一理想，如果成员无法立即体验到这种平静，应通过训练来达成。
训练方法。不应做的事项：
1) 不吃肉。要记住，吃肉是一种动物本能，也是所有恶习的根源。
2) 不陷入绝望。要记住，悲伤是错误行为的结果。
3) 不发怒。不耐烦是执着于生活琐事的结果。为了避免愤怒和不耐烦，必须关注更重要的事情。
4) 不嫉妒。嫉妒是懒惰的结果。为了实现愿望，必须努力工作。
5) 不评判邻居。评判邻居是轻率的表现。
6) 不说谎。说谎是懦弱的结果，会降低一个人的尊严。为了不撒谎，一个人应始终自尊自爱。
7) 不在思想中犯通奸罪。通奸是杂念和虚荣的结果。
应做的事项：
1) 始终保持快乐、自信、愉快和友好。多笑、多唱、多跳舞，欣赏自然和花卉。在私人生活中像孩子一样，在公共生活中像狮子一样。
2) 在爱情中保持理智，避免犯错。
建立内心平静的结果是青春永驻，疾病和死亡消失。达到理想境界的人将成为不朽者。
II) 在人类中建立和平与安宁。
1) 使人类摆脱当今的疾病——红色布尔什维主义。布尔什维主义是人类自身罪恶的结果。一旦“建立正义联盟”发展到足够规模，以赎清人类迄今为止所犯的罪行，布尔什维主义就会消失。
2) 各国人民的兄弟般团结。
3) 向没有土地的人民捐赠土地。
无论性别、年龄、地位、国籍和宗教如何，任何人都可以成为联盟成员。
所有那些不愿成为联盟成员的人将被称作“掘墓人”，那些犹豫不决的人将被称作“迷途者”，而联盟成员将被称作“建设者”。任何达到理想境界的成员将被称作“利己主义者”，并成为另一个存在领域的参与者，从而获得全能的天赋。

Z. 韦尔尼娜（Vernina），
联盟发起人和第一位成员。

编者按：- 本文件由发起人本人提交给我们，我们出于提供信息的目的予以刊登。我们无法完全理解为何所有非素食者以及未注册为联盟成员的人都被称为“掘墓人”。我们担心在这种情况下，“掘墓人”的数量将比联盟成员多出数百万。

The "Zarya" continued.

The "Union of Justice"

On Friday, February 22 Z. S. Voronina will give a lecture
on the subject of "What is the Union of Justice?" at 5.30 p.m.
at the Club of Russian Merchants, No. 8 Yates Road. Entrance
free.

Russian. Mussulman Union in Hankow.

The Mussulman Union in Hankow has expelled from its
membership one Ibrahim Ilchikaeff, who upon admission was
found to be a Soviet Citizen and anti-ex Russian citizens
of the old regime. Another member expelled is one Ahmed
Hasiev, who has committed some offence for which he is on trial.

1000th issue of the "Shanghai Zarya".

On February 26 the "Shanghai Zarya" will publish its
1000th issue in Shanghai. Later on there will be a special
illustrated issue to commemorate the event published and
distributed amongst subscribers.

《霞报》续闻。

“正义联盟”

2月22日星期五，Z. S. 沃罗尼娜将于下午5时30分在亚茨路8号俄国商人俱乐部发表题为“什么是正义联盟？”的演讲。免费入场。

汉口穆斯林联盟。

汉口穆斯林联盟已开除一名易卜拉欣·伊尔奇卡耶夫（Ibrahim Ilchikaeff）的会籍，经查其在入会时被发现是苏联公民，且反对前政权的俄罗斯旧公民。另一名被开除的成员是艾哈迈德·哈谢夫（Ahmed Hasiev），他因犯下某种罪行正在受审。

《上海霞报》第1000期。

2月26日，《上海霞报》将在上海出版其第1000期。随后将出版一期特别的插图纪念刊，并向订阅者分发。
